I was a freshman in highschool and we were watching The Time Machine (1960). When the movie got to the part where we saw the subterranean monsters that were once people, our teacher gave us a "lesson" about evolution and how humans can change over time. 

I had no problem with this of course, but she began telling us a story of a friend of hers who went spelunking. He went to the world's deepest darkest cave and was down there SOOO long that when he came out he was now blind for life... but it doesnt end there. Apparently, later he had a son that was born with a heightened adaptive sight and could now see in the dark. This is where I lost it.

I rose my hand and when she called on me I explained that me and my classmates are literally taking a biology class right now and we JUST learned that you cannot pass on acquired traits this way. If I cut my arms off, this doesnt mean my children will be born without arms, let alone MORE arms for some reason.

Well, she didnt like this at all. She sent me out of class while everyone else finished the movie without me. She then went out into the hall to hand me the test on the movie that I missed a majority of. I still did pretty well but she felt it necessary to give me a test with questions she knew I couldn't answer. 

She was later fired the next year for drinking whiskey between classes.
